warnings.planBlock: E3/E4 SU_ABORT -> FBAndNotRunSu (interlock tolerance) / PS_RND (PLC R&D permit)
warnings.analysis: At abort set the same consumers are already blocked by NOT recRndC_SU (prev-scan SU=TRUE), so no permissive window; at abort end permit returns 1 scan late (conservative).

warnings.planBlock: E5 SafetyFault up-block SF_UPBLK -> PA_CFG.AndIn8
warnings.analysis: If SafetyFault latches in the same scan as a CFG command edge, CFG is accepted (block seen next scan) == legal order "CFG accepted, then fault 1 scan later"; SU/BA up-blocks are same-scan. No 2-state scan; residual: up-block not effective in the coincidence scan.

warnings.planBlock: E5 WD_EMG -> FBAnd37.AndIn5 -> FBEstop1.EStopIn3 (FBAnd37->FBEstop1 pre-existing lag)

warnings.planBlock: E6v / S6-fix: HEALTHY_OK.AndIn4 duplicate of AndIn3 (min-2 input rule)
warnings.analysis: AND(x,x)=x with the same symbol, same timing as AndIn3 (pre-existing E2b read): zero behavioural delta.

warnings.planBlock: E4 Config entry PA_CFG -> STATE_CFG/FBRs5(Step1)/FBRs7/FBRs9 resets
warnings.safetyPath: Config entry; LV/HV discharge latches reset
warnings.analysis: All 4 consumers of the 1-scan pulse read it in the same scan k+1 -> Step1 reset and STATE_CFG set in the same scan (no 0/2-state scan; stand rule 5 holds in all runs). Partial reordering of only some consumers WOULD create a 0/2-state scan - keep together.

warnings.planBlock: E4 PA_CFG guard linkSafeUpScope
